summary.text: Engineering executive who aligns regulated release discipline and governed agentic platform architecture into a single operating model for enterprise-scale delivery. As SVP of Engineering, that leader architected the agentic AI platform control plane that now anchors production deployment. Software dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis, exposes architecture dependency chains, and improves transformation visibility across enterprise complexity. In parallel, replay-key controls manifests pair with human-override escalation paths to keep the runtime auditable rather than opaque. The same platform discipline carried release automation and security scanning into regulated modernization delivery paths, reinforcing production reliability across programs. That governed architecture and delivery lineage together drove platform productization and IP-led revenue growth, generating $22M in monetized platform IP and establishing a repeatable model for scaling governed AI systems into new enterprise and partner contexts.
